description:
Wait for the user to choose on the pick page. Long-polls up to 50 seconds—returns as soon as
they click, or status "pending" after the wait (call again if so).

Once chosen, returns their reference with its screenshot and a full build prompt, so you can
start building from it immediately. If they clicked "None of these fit", status is "dismissed"
and you should ask what they want instead.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a choice, 0 to 50.

name: wait_for_pick

scope.description:
What was captured. marketing: logged-out marketing pages only. public-demo: logged out, but real
product surfaces or public demos were used. task-incomplete: signed in, but the journey stops before
its result. signed-in: signed in, and the journey reaches its result.
